source_excerpts.title: Relative syzygy gluing across a Semaev chain separator
source_excerpts.mechanism: Write the chain ideal as two overlapping ideals in rings sharing the separator variable. Relations intrinsic to either side are already explained. The remaining quotient records compatibility relations across the separator, analogous to a fiber-product or mapping-cone correction. A small separator in the variable graph does not guarantee low algebraic degree; it may transmit exponentially complicated elimination data. The proposed object measures that missing algebra directly. Signatures and minimal non-rewritable generators remain the claim-carrying quantities, preserving the question's requirement to avoid the old normality proxy.
